# Future Trends: 10 Fastest Growing Industries In The Next 5 Years
## Top 10 fastest-growing industries through 2030
### 2. Renewable energy
**CAGR: 17.2%**

We all rely on energy to get through our daily lives. Whether powering the lights in our homes or fueling our personal vehicles and public transit, the demand for energy isn’t slowing down anytime soon. In fact, [according to Next Move Strategy Consulting](https://www.nextmsc.com/report/power-generation-market), the overall global energy generation sector has a CAGR of 8.2% through 2030.

In particular, renewables will shine moving forward, with global renewable electricity generation expected to increase by nearly 90% by 2030, compared to 2023, [according to the International Energy Agency](https://www.iea.org/energy-system/renewables). As [Grand View Research reported](https://www.grandviewresearch.com/industry-analysis/renewable-energy-market), renewables are expected to reach a CAGR of over 17%.

With worsening impacts of climate change, more and more individuals, organizations, and governments are transitioning to cleaner energy sources that produce less emissions compared to fossil fuels. Meanwhile, the human population continues to increase, meaning higher demand for energy generation. Increasing numbers of data centers also require more energy.

By combining innovation and technology, the energy sector is set to both grow rapidly and move toward more renewable sources, such as solar, wind, and hydropower to meet demand.

Generate Capital is a major name in the clean energy space, and it has raised over [$7.1B](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/generate-capital) since it was founded in 2014. Diversification. By focusing on building and operating everything from energy storage and solar to electric vehicles and charging infrastructure, the company has been able to increase demand for sustainable products and services in a wide variety of markets.

Then, there’s the emerging success of Realta Fusion, a startup focused on developing a zero-carbon method of producing heat and electricity. It recently raised [$36M](https://techcrunch.com/2025/05/13/realta-fusion-taps-36m-in-fresh-funds-for-its-fusion-in-a-bottle-reactor/) in Series A funding to finalize its prototype reactor design, which could lead to a breakthrough in low-cost, zero-emissions energy production.

Many more companies could see similarly successful funding rounds and long-term financial health by pursuing the clean energy sector.

### 3. B2B
**CAGR: 16.17%**

Some of the most successful, fastest-growing startups today fall into the B2B category, including Databricks (with a $63B valuation), Checkout.com ($40B valuation), CoreWeave ($23B), and Miro ($17B).

### 4. Healthtech
**CAGR: 13.1%**

Healthcare, and healthtech in particular, continues to grow quickly, and many sectors within healthtech are seeing higher growth rates.

For example, healthcare predictive analysis is anticipated to have a 24.4% CAGR through 2030, while robot-assisted surgery is expected to have a CAGR of [13.54%](https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/robotic-assisted-surgery-systems-market) through the end of this decade. In general, the healthtech sector is anticipated to reach a market size of [$3.14T by 2033](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/healthtech-market-size-to-reach-3-140-9-billion-by-2033-globally-at-13-1-cagr-allied-market-research-302428710.html), with a CAGR of 13.1% through 2033.

In return, patients will receive faster answers and treatment. The sector is anticipated to grow, too, because of more interest and investment in preventive care.

Some of the unicorns in the healthtech industry include Devoted Health ( [$13B](https://www.clay.com/dossier/devoted-health-funding) valuation), a comprehensive healthcare and insurance company aimed at providing healthcare to older adults, and Zocdoc ( [$1.8B valuation](https://www.startengine.com/offering/zocdoc)), a platform that makes it easier for patients to schedule in-person and virtual appointments with healthcare professionals.

### 5. Cryptocurrency/blockchain
**CAGR: 13.1% (cryptocurrency), 58.3% (blockchain)**

Cryptocurrency has been making headlines for years, and it’s not going away anytime soon.

This industry is slated to reach a CAGR of [13.1%](https://www.grandviewresearch.com/industry-analysis/cryptocurrency-market-report) over the next five years, while blockchain will be one of the fastest-growing industries with a CAGR of [58.3%](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/03/05/3037648/0/en/Blockchain-Technology-Market-Outlook-2025-2030-with-Blockchain-Market-Case-Studies-for-Honeywell-Aerospace-SGX-Zug-Digital-ING-Group-and-more.html) and an anticipated market size of $306B by 2030.

What explains this intense growth? Blockchain is revolutionizing the financial industry, but it’s also useful in other industries, such as telecommunications. It makes data easier to secure and trace while also reducing the costs of managing this data.

As for cryptocurrency, this sector continues to grow because it is a digital asset, and the technology allows for the decentralization of finances. These sectors go hand-in-hand, as cryptocurrency is built upon blockchain technology.

One of the biggest companies in the blockchain space is also one of the most well-known companies in the world: IBM. IBM has developed its own blockchain network to increase efficiency, productivity, and traceability while also gaining an edge in this field as a trusted enterprise name. As for the crypto space, Binance stands out among competitors. This crypto-exchange platform has a valuation of around [$62B](https://www.binance.com/en-TR/square/post/14148805043041).

### 6. Cybersecurity
**CAGR: 12.9%**

As such, we can expect to see around a 12.9% CAGR through 2030 for the cybersecurity industry, [according to Grand View Research](https://www.grandviewresearch.com/industry-analysis/cyber-security-market).

Cybersecurity Trends for 2025 and Beyond - YouTube

Tap to unmute

[Cybersecurity Trends for 2025 and Beyond](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kqaMIFEz15s) [IBM Technology](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCKWaEZ-_VweaEx1j62do_vQ)

![thumbnail-image](https://yt3.ggpht.com/7qCmNHAsFvD6RSINuJ1WoGZYoKmm7TDnhORKFqLb8QoeOFh2qFXal8brkzoxNrwqmJTuvOLs=s68-c-k-c0x00ffffff-no-rj)

IBM Technology1.76M subscribers

[Watch on](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kqaMIFEz15s)

Cloud-based cybersecurity solutions are especially coveted moving forward, as both businesses and individuals are adopting cloud-based storage and services more and more.

[Large enterprises](https://www.hubspot.com/startups/science-of-scaling/ed-calnan-founder-seismic), in particular, are showing great demand for enhanced cybersecurity, including for cloud-based services, which creates an opportunity for startups to innovate and provide unique products and services in the space.

1Password ( [$6.8B valuation](https://sacra.com/c/1password/)) is an example of a successful cybersecurity company that has revolutionized the space. By storing all of a user’s passwords securely, the user no longer has to either remember several different passwords or risk their security by using the same password for multiple sites.

### 7. Software
**CAGR: 11.3%**

Software will continue to be an in-demand industry as we continue to rely on the digital landscape for personal and professional use cases.

The overall software industry is expected to reach a CAGR of [11.3%](https://www.grandviewresearch.com/industry-analysis/software-market-report) through 2030, with software-as-a-service (SaaS) forecasted to grow at a [12% CAGR](https://www.grandviewresearch.com/industry-analysis/saas-market-report) through the same period.

More advanced technology, like our smartphones and computers, makes it more important than ever to have high-tech, state-of-the-art software to do everything from manage customer data (with a handy [CRM](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/startups?hubs_content=www.hubspot.com/startups/reports/hypergrowth-startups/fastest-growing-industries&hubs_content-cta=crm)) at work to playing high-resolution video games with friends.

People will continue to need software as we manage more aspects of our lives digitally, hence the high growth anticipated for this sector.

Think of some of the tools you use at work, and you’ll be able to pinpoint successful software startups. Companies like Stripe ($70B valuation) and Canva ($20B) are not just unicorns of the software industry, but they are some of the fastest-growing, highest-valued startups in the world, across all industries, according to the Hypergrowth Startup Index.

### 8. IT
**CAGR: 8.38%**

Individuals, businesses, and governments all rely on IT, and increasing interest in cloud storage and services is also driving growth for this sector, as is the rise in remote work since the COVID-19 pandemic.

# 10 Global Industries That Will Boom in the Next 5 Years
This sector is consistently cited as having the highest growth potential.

Cell and Gene Therapy

With numerous clinical trials and new treatments coming to market, the CAGR is consistently projected to be well over 15-20%.  [Cell and Gene Therapy Market](https://www.marketresearch.com/Coherent-Market-Insights-v4137/Cell-Gene-Therapy-41962743/) to Coherent Market Insights, they estimate that the value of the global cell and gene therapy market is at $24.4 Bn in 2025 and exhibiting a CAGR of 18.5% during the forecast period (2025-2032). Additionally, many specific types of therapies, such as CAR-T Cell, are forecasted to have a 2023-2030 CAGR of over 35% globally, as explained in [Global CAR T-Cell Therapy Market Size Study & Forecast](https://www.marketresearch.com/Bizwit-Research-Consulting-v4223/Global-CAR-Cell-therapy-Size-39272698/) by BizwitResearch & Consulting.

This market is expected to grow at a CAGR of around 20% or more.  [Healthcare Analytics](https://www.marketresearch.com/Global-Industry-Analysts-v1039/Healthcare-Analytics-41281635/) (from Global Industry Analysts) sets the global market for Healthcare Analytics at an estimated $64.5 billion in the year 2024, and is expected to reach $218.0 billion by 2030, growing at a CAGR of 22.5% over the analysis period 2024-2030.

Financial Analytics, one of the segments analyzed in the report, is expected to record a 23.8% CAGR and reach $97.7 billion by the end of the analysis period. Growth in the Clinical Analytics segment is estimated at 22.4% CAGR over the analysis period.

Augmented Reality (AR) Technologies

Augmented Reality (AR) has experienced remarkable growth due to the widespread utilization of this technology in commercial settings.

Mordor Intelligence’s [Virtual Augmented and Mixed Reality (VR/AR) Market Size, Growth Trends, Share & Companies (2025 - 2030)](https://www.marketresearch.com/Mordor-Intelligence-LLP-v4018/Virtual-Augmented-Mixed-Reality-VR-40957722/) states that The Virtual Augmented and Mixed Reality Market size is estimated at $157.44 billion in 2025, and is expected to reach $865.36 billion by 2030, at a CAGR of 40.61% during the forecast period (2025-2030)

Hydrogen Engines and Fuel Cell Technology

MarketsandMarkets takes a closer look at all types of fuel cells in [Fuel Cell Market by Type (PEMFC, SOFC, PAFC, MFC, DMFC, AFC), Application (Portable, Stationary, FCVs), End User (Residential, Commercial & Industrial, Transportation, Data Center, Military), Size, Fuel Type, Component and Region - Global Forecast to 2030](https://www.marketresearch.com/MarketsandMarkets-v3719/Fuel-Cell-Type-PEMFC-SOFC-41605669/) and notes: The global fuel cell market is projected to reach $18.16 billion by 2030 from $5.66 billion in 2025, registering a CAGR of 26.3%.

Fuel cell technology is advancing, leading to improved efficiencies, the development of new materials, and reduced costs.

3D Cell Culture

In the report [3D Cell Culture Technologies Global Market Report 2025](https://www.marketresearch.com/Business-Research-Company-v4006/3D-Cell-Culture-Technologies-Global-42248710/), The Business Research Company notes that the 3D cell culture technologies market size has grown rapidly in recent years.

Edge Security

Neuromorphic Computing

Anti-Obesity Drugs

[Anti-Obesity Drugs Market Research Report by Treatment Type [Appetite Suppressants (Serotonin Norepinephrine Reuptake Inhibitors, Selective Serotonin 2C Receptor Agonists, Norepinephrine Dopamine Reuptake Inhibitors), Lipase Inhibitors, GLP-1 Receptor Agonists…](https://www.marketresearch.com/One-Off-Publisher-Market-Research-Future-v4094/Anti-Obesity-Drugs-Research-Treatment-42004759/) from Market Research Future, forecasts that the global anti-obesity drugs market is expected to expand to $326.8969 billion by 2035, registering a CAGR of 25.82% during 2025–2035.   
  
Advanced pharmacological therapies, especially GLP-1 receptor agonists and dual receptor medicines like tirzepatide, are achieving weight reduction to never-before-seen levels, along with metabolic health improvement. Companies in the pharmaceutical industry, such as Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk, are the main drivers of this change.   
  
Digital Education (EdTech)  
  
The widespread adoption of remote learning and online education platforms continues to drive the EdTech market. Some specific subsectors, such as Corporate E-Learning and MOOC (Massive Open Online Course) are poised for even more remarkable growth. Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) are digital learning platforms that offer a wide variety of courses, making high-quality education accessible globally to anyone with an internet connection.
